profile.name: Ashrafuzzaman
profile.headline: Finance & Accounting Professional | CMA Aspirant (ICMAB)
profile.subheadline: Financial Reporting, Reconciliation & Internal Controls | QuickBooks Online Advanced Certified ProAdvisor
profile.summary: CMA aspirant and Finance & Banking graduate with over two years of hands-on experience in full-cycle bookkeeping, financial reporting, reconciliation, and internal controls across multi-entity environments. Recognized for accuracy, problem-solving, and clear communication, with adaptability to fast-paced and hybrid working environments.

about.heading: About Me
about.body: I am a finance and accounting professional committed to integrity, discipline, and continuous growth. My work spans full-cycle bookkeeping, financial reporting, reconciliations, and internal controls across multi-entity environments. I value professionalism in every engagement and strive to deliver accurate, reliable, and timely financial information.
highlights: Over two years of hands-on experience in accounting and finance
Monthly financial statements, adjusted trial balances, and consolidated MIS reporting for 17+ SBUs
Experienced with ERP (iBOS), QuickBooks Online, SQL, and Excel automation
Strong focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and audit-ready documentation
about.quote: Integrity and professionalism guide my work, and my faith guides my character.

values.heading: Values & Faith
values.intro: My personal and professional life is guided by faith, ethics, and a commitment to excellence.

principles.title: Faith in Islam
principles.text: My belief in Islam shapes my character, sense of responsibility, and conduct. I strive to uphold honesty, humility, gratitude, and accountability in all that I do.

principles.title: Integrity
principles.text: I believe trust is built through transparency, truthfulness, and ethical action. I aim to be dependable and principled, especially when handling financial responsibilities.

principles.title: Professionalism
principles.text: I am committed to quality work, respectful communication, continuous learning, and delivering results with diligence and care.

values.closing: These values influence how I learn, collaborate, and contribute to every organization and community I am part of.

experience.description: Prepare monthly financial statements, adjusted trial balances, and closing entries for multiple Strategic Business Units (SBUs), ensuring complete reconciliation with ERP records.
bullets: Develop consolidated and comparative financial reports using dynamic Excel models linked to ERP data from iBOS.
Perform bank, intercompany, general ledger, and AR/AP reconciliations; investigate variances and post adjusting journal entries.
Prepare customer and supplier aging analyses, maintain receivable ledgers, and reconcile collection records.
Prepare audit schedules, supporting schedules, and financial working papers with rigorous verification.
Develop MIS reports and Executive Committee (EC) presentations; document process flows, approval matrices, and internal controls.
Extract and analyze journal, GL, and invoice data using SQL; automate recurring reports with advanced Excel and Python (openpyxl).

experience.description: Managed full-cycle bookkeeping across multiple industries using QuickBooks Online.
bullets: Recorded daily transactions, performed monthly categorization, and maintained accurate general ledger records.
Performed bank and credit card reconciliations to ensure accuracy and resolve discrepancies.
Handled Accounts Payable and Receivable, including multi-currency vendor transactions and payment tracking.
Prepared monthly financial reports including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and AR/AP aging reports.
Maintained and updated Chart of Accounts, tax codes, and financial structures for multiple entities.
Prepared financial records that supported statutory audit review; contributed to leave/time tracking and payroll workflow design.

experience.description: Supported clients with reconciliations, categorization, and financial reporting in QuickBooks Online.
bullets: Performed bank reconciliations and transaction categorization for business and individual clients.
Prepared monthly and annual financial statements using QuickBooks Online.
Analyzed financial data and improved accuracy of reporting and transaction classification.
Assisted clients in maintaining organized and audit-ready accounting records.
Verified physical inventory and validated stock counts.
Reconciled inventory records with system data and reported discrepancies.
Collaborated with warehouse teams to ensure inventory accuracy and compliance.
Conducted physical inventory verification and stock count validation.
Reconciled inventory records with system data and reported discrepancies.
Collaborated with warehouse teams to ensure inventory accuracy and compliance.
